# The label update nobody owns

A gallery label still names an exhibition that closed in June. Every department assumes another owns it. Added an owner and review date to the label file, not another general reminder email. [[Exhibition plan]] records the harbour archive handover clearly; we can borrow that small administrative habit without reopening the finished project.
